about: Wanted: Dead is a hybrid slasher and third-person shooter from Team NINJA, the makers of Ninja Gaiden and Dead or Alive.
The game follows a week in life of the Zombie Unit, an elite Hong Kong police squad on a mission to uncover a major corporate conspiracy.

Play as Hannah Stone, a badass police officer, to power through mercenaries, gang members and private security forces in a spectacular cyberpunk adventure. Steel your resolve and get to the bottom of the world's secrets.
The team is made of: - Lt. Hannah Stone, a no nonsense hard boiled Hong Kong cop with phenomenal sword moves and catlike reflexes.
- Sgt. Arnold Herzog, a loudmouth marksman with dirty jokes for days.
- Sgt. Manolo Cortez, a mute brute that always has everyone’s back.
